# Marketing copywriting (Marketing Skills)

Writes and rewrites landing, pricing and product page copy that sounds human and converts.

- Source: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/main/skills/copywriting/SKILL.md
- Author: Corey Haines
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/marketing-copywriting-marketing-skills-78c35e89

Triggers on requests to write or improve website copy: headlines, hero sections, value propositions, CTAs and full page structures. Claude first gathers context about the product and audience, then applies copywriting principles, page-specific frameworks and a list of 'AI tells' to avoid. Reference files and eval cases are included.

**Try asking:**
- "Rewrite our homepage hero, it sounds like AI slop"
- "Write copy for our pricing page"
- "Give me 10 headline options for this landing page"
